messages:
omar (release-mgr): Starting a dry-run for staged rollout v3.4.2 -> 10% eu-west (change window 2h). Deploybot will shift 10% to canary. CI artifacts: sha=abc123. Need quick QA smoke and confirm rollback playbook. @tessa @ben

deploy-bot: Deploy started: job 45821, canary group eu-west-1a. Logs: https://ci.internal/45821. To abort: `/deploy abort 45821`

tessa (qa): Running smoke suite now (smoke/infra + embeddings). ETA ~6m. Will post failures inline. :eyes:

ben (infra): Checked autoscaler and routing. KV cache warmup scheduled. If we see kvcache-oom alert, recommended pin back to v3.4.1 and scale to 6 pods. :+1:

ci-bot: Smoke results: 0 failures in infra smoke. Embedding latency P95 jumped from 42ms -> 70ms on one node (eu-west-1a). Sample trace: trace/789. Marking as observation.

jamie (sre): Seeing a small tail in tokenization for long prompts in canary. Not an error yet but watching. If latency P99 > 1.5s for >5min, vote to hold. Also added alert: canary-eu-high-tail.

tessa (qa): Found 2 reranking mismatches in canary vs prod on nightly testset. Not sure it's real; tagging @omar. I'll attach examples in a follow-up thread. For now I recommend hold at 10% until we investigate. :hand:

omar (release-mgr): Thanks. Hold the rollout. Can we pin traffic back? @deploy-bot please pause. Also record release note: 'investigating rerank discrepancy'

deploy-bot: Canary paused. Current traffic remains 10% but will not advance. To rollback traffic to pinned version run `/deploy revert 45821 --to v3.4.1`

ben (infra): If we decide to revert, I'll prep capacity for immediate failback. Estimate 7m. Also suggest we run a quick A/B compare with a 1% shadow to confirm differences.

omar (release-mgr): Agreed. Let's not revert yet. Tessa, please dump diffs + request eval perf for top-5 examples. Jamie keep alert on. Re-assigning canary owner to ben for infra ops. :white_check_mark:

tessa (qa): Will send diffs in ~10min. If nothing obvious, we can resume to 25% after root-cause or revert. :shipit:?
